description: [1HLabs FHE Blind Routing & B2A Commerce Attestation Gateway (#82)] Evaluates blinded financial policy hashes and selects suggested routing between Bitcoin Lightning L402 (Patrol / Streaming) and Solana SPL-USDC (Strike / Client-Side PDA Template) without exposing master balances under Model A Non-Custodial B2B SaaS.

blinded_policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the client confidential financial spending limit or encrypted threshold

client_public_identity.description: Public DID, agent label, or treasury identity for attestation binding

dry_run.description: Dry-Run Software Simulation mode. When true, returns locked preview quote with settlement_token without committing funds.

estimated_ticket_band.description: Economic ticket scale determining gas and client-side template parameters

intent_category.description: Operational phase: continuous patrol vs. atomic settlement strike

settlement_token.description: Optional dry-run settlement token (tok_dry_...) to redeem a previously locked preview quote.
